scenes.say: Your ground coffee goes stale fast.
Ground coffee has more surface than beans. Air reaches it faster. Heat and moisture speed it up too.
Use an airtight container. Keep it cool and dark. Away from the stove.
A closed pantry shelf works well. A sunny counter does not.

scenes.title: The tip.
scenes.say: Close the lid right after scooping. Open means air and steam.
Closed, cool, dark and dry. Save this for your kitchen.
